# Aegis AI

> Enterprise AI operations platform that connects business systems via MCP and APIs so specialised AI agents can monitor, optimise, and orchestrate operations with human approval.

Aegis AI unifies incident management, cloud cost optimisation, licence utilisation, security posture, and contact centre analytics. Every AI-proposed action flows through a change control workflow with risk scoring, required approvals, rollback plans, and an immutable audit trail.

## Pages

- [Command Center](/): Operational findings, posture, dashboards, attention and governed action.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Operational trends, findings, reports, filtering and evidence.
- [Vulnerabilities](/investigations): Prioritized operational and security findings with evidence and remediation context.
- [AI Agents](/agents): Deployed agents plus verified definitions available for deployment.
- [Ask Aegis](/chat): Full-page conversational interface over authorized enterprise systems and knowledge.
- [Approval Center](/approvals): Change records with risk scores, approvals, and change windows.
- [Integrations](/integrations): Connect enterprise systems and manage provider instances.
- [Audit Viewer](/audit): Trace platform activity and governed actions.

## Optional

- [Team & Roles](/users): Role-based access for Admin, Manager, Analyst, and Viewer.
- [Settings](/settings): Workspace appearance and retention configuration.
